text:
hannah: noticed a cluster of mTLS handshake drops after the cert-rotator run at 02:42 UTC
sven: saw it too in us-west-1, TLS alert 50 and KMS errors in cloudtrail
claire: I pushed a RBAC tighten for `vault-rotator` to remove broad `kms:ListKeys` and `kms:DescribeKey` earlier in maintenance window
infra-bot: deploy: cert-rotator v1.8.0 applied -> job rotated certs + updated keystore aliases
ops-oncall: impact: ~48 failed handshakes across us-west-1 and sa-east-1, some clients retried and observed higher latency
sven: cloudtrail shows `AccessDenied` on `Decrypt` for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-1:111122223333:key/zzzz-yyyx during unwrap attempts
hannah: looks like keystore alias rewrites pointed at regional staging key in sa-east then rotator tried to decrypt in us-west; cross-region alias mismatch
claire: the RBAC change also prevented proxy-introspect from calling `kms:DescribeKey` so proxies couldn't detect region mismatch and fell back to failing handshake
ops-oncall: mitigation: (1) revert RBAC patch at 02:48 UTC to restore DescribeKey for `proxy-introspect` scoped to `arn:aws:kms:us-west-1:111122223333:key/*` (2) roll back alias rewrite for the affected hosts
infra-bot: revert applied, proxies recovered ~70s after revert, handshake errors down to baseline
audit-bot: note: mtls_event sampling is 2% and redaction removed `key_arn` and `alias` fields by default; triage slowed
hannah: follow-ups: (A) add a region-validation step to rotator: `aws kms describe-key --key-id $target_key --region $expected` and fail if mismatch (B) update RBAC change checklist to include KMS metadata dependency enumeration
sven: also add a short-lived policy template for rollouts: allow `kms:DescribeKey` + `kms:Decrypt` only with conditions `aws:RequestedRegion` and `kms:ViaService` where possible
claire: I'll author a terraform module `rotator-region-guard` and a pre-deploy canary that runs in each region verifying alias->key mapping and a full unwrap path
ops-oncall: I'll create audit override: increase mtls_event sampling to 25% in us-west-1 for 8h and preserve unredacted mtls_event bundle to secure-audit with envelope encryption and 90d retention
audit-bot: requested artifacts: proxy logs, rotator job logs, terraform plan, IAM policy diff, cloudtrail KMS events, secure-audit bundle
hannah: owners: @claire for terraform + RBAC checklist, @sven for region-guard tests & canary job, @ops-oncall to run sampling override and collect artifacts
claire: scheduling 30m postmortem sync at 09:15 UTC to review checklist and PRs :thumbsup:
